name: GoDaddy Domains
description: GoDaddy Domains automation: domains, DNS records, availability & discovery, domain privacy

a1a1.name: list
a1a1.description: Retrieve a list of Domains for the specified Shopper

a1a1.name: get
a1a1.description: Retrieve details for the specified Domain

a1a1.name: update
a1a1.description: Update details for the specified Domain

a1a1.name: purchase
a1a1.description: Purchase and register the specified Domain

a1a1.name: recordGet
a1a1.description: Retrieve DNS Records for the specified Domain, optionally with the specified Type and/or Name

a1a1.name: recordReplaceTypeName
a1a1.description: Replace all DNS Records for the specified Domain with the specified Type and Name

a1a1.name: recordDeleteTypeName
a1a1.description: Delete all DNS Records for the specified Domain with the specified Type and Name

a1a1.name: recordAdd
a1a1.description: Add the specified DNS Records to the specified Domain

a1a1.name: available
a1a1.description: Determine whether or not the specified domain is available for purchase

a1a1.name: availableBulk
a1a1.description: Determine whether or not the specified domains are available for purchase

a1a1.name: suggest
a1a1.description: Suggest alternate Domain names based on a seed Domain, a set of keywords, or the shopper's purchase history

a1a1.name: purchasePrivacy
a1a1.description: Purchase privacy for a specified domain

a1a1.name: cancelPrivacy
a1a1.description: Submit a privacy cancellation request for the given domain
